qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M70/S70/M73 cylinder head bolts?
What are the torque angle specifications for 7AZ cylinder head bolts after the initial torque?
What engine types use the M60/1/M60/2/M62 cylinder head bolt specification?
qa_pairs.answer: M60/1/M60/2/M62 engine types use this specification under section 8AZ

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque angle between 7AZ and 8AZ cylinder head bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: 7AZ uses 60° torque angles while 8AZ uses 80° torque angles

qa_pairs.question: What is the initial torque value for M60/1/M60/2/M62 cylinder head bolts?
What special instruction is given for cylinder head bolt installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Fit new cylinder head bolts, do not wash away coating on cylinder head screws, and for repair work only use screws with Torx head

qa_pairs.question: How many torque angle steps are required for 8AZ cylinder head bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: Two torque angle steps of 80° each

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection covers cylinder head with cover specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 11-8 Engine, subsection 11 12 Cylinder head with cover

qa_pairs.question: Are the initial torque values the same for both 7AZ and 8AZ cylinder head bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both 7AZ and 8AZ cylinder head bolts have the same initial torque value of 30 Nm
